name: dil-connector
description: DSP/DCP connector with tenant-specific public identity and catalog metadata.
helm_values:
connector:
  publicHost: dil-connector.{tenant_host}
  publicBaseUrl: https://dil-connector.{tenant_host}
catalog:
  participantId: did:web:dil-connector.{tenant_host}:identity
  serviceEndpointUrl: https://dil-connector.{tenant_host}/api/dsp
dcp:
  holderDid: did:web:dil-connector.{tenant_host}:identity
  issuerDid: did:web:dil-connector.{tenant_host}:issuer
  verifierDid: did:web:dil-connector.{tenant_host}:verifier
  thirdPartyDid: did:web:dil-connector.{tenant_host}:thirdparty
  credentialServiceEndpoint: https://dil-connector.{tenant_host}
  issuerServiceEndpoint: https://dil-connector.{tenant_host}
  verifierTriggerEndpoint: https://dil-connector.{tenant_host}/api/trigger
